assumptions: Periodic ROI
Spatial iid approximately Gaussian marginal noise

limitations: No independence or correspondence proof
No scene boundary/motion model

Nonperiodic detail leaks across frequencies

RGB common mask can carry weak-channel noise

No HLSL/runtime/game acceptance
